claims: Braylon Mullins is from Greenfield, Indiana.
Braylon Mullins is a 6'6" shooting guard.
Braylon Mullins attended Greenfield-Central High School.
Braylon Mullins committed to the University of Connecticut (UConn).
Braylon Mullins was recognized as Indiana's Mr. Basketball.
Braylon Mullins is a McDonald's All-American.
Braylon Mullins chose UConn over local options like Indiana University.
As of the 2025-2026 season, Braylon Mullins is a freshman guard for the UConn Huskies.
